definition: much higher in some quality or degree; much above the ordinary or average; existing in a high degree; intense.
example_en: This meal was excellent.

definition: having no bounds; unlimited; boundless.
example_en: His knowledge was boundless.

definition: a structure of stone, bricks, mud or wood with a flat roof and usu. open on all sides for providing shelter for travellers.
example_en: The travellers rested in the wayside shelter.

definition: to engage in a mutual fighting.
example_en: The two armies engaged in mutual fighting at the border.

definition: a clothing with a narrow strip of cloth for being fastened (as loose under-skirt reaching partway to the knee); a petticoat.
example: ಚಳಿಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳು ಕಸೆಪಾವಡೆ ಧರಿಸಿ ಮನೆಗೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: In winter she wore a petticoat and did the housework.

definition: a harmonious living together (of husband and wife).
example_en: Their harmonious married life had continued for years.

definition: a man who advertises (something) esp. in a newspapers, radio or television.
example_en: That advertiser placed an advertisement in the newspaper.

definition: to treat contemptuously; to belittle; to slight.
example_en: The rich merchant treated his servant contemptuously.

definition: a pawn used in the game of dice.
example_en: One pawn was lost in the dice game.

definition: sweetish water; water that is fit to be drunk.
example_en: Sweet drinking water was found in the well.

definition: a physician; a doctor.
example_en: The doctor examined the patient.

definition: (collectively) dried leaves of a plants; trash; rubbish; refuse.
example_en: The farmers burnt the dried leaves and made manure.

definition: for or to suit the present situation (without general application); temporarily.
example_en: This arrangement has been made only temporarily to suit the present situation.

definition: to be accomplished, achieved, fulfilled.
example_en: His dream was finally accomplished.

definition: one who works very hard; he who is given to hardworking.
example_en: He is famous in the company as one who works very hard.

definition: the state of being turned inward; inversion.
example_en: Due to the pipe's inward turn, the direction of the water changed.

definition: to form a line.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಶಿಸ್ತಿನಿಂದ ಓಳಿಗೊಳ್ ಎಂದು ಗುರುಗಳು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher told the children to form a line in an orderly way.

definition: not adulterated; free from impurity; pure; clean.
example_en: This is pure ghee, free from impurity.

definition: a kind of sweetmeat, made of sugar or jaggery, sesame seeds, etc.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಅಮ್ಮ ಲೇವಡಿಯನ್ನು ಸಿಹಿಯಾಗಿ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: On the festival day, mother prepared the sweet lēvaḍi deliciously.

definition: more than one type or kind; several types, sorts, variety or class.
example_en: Many kinds of clothes are available in this shop.

definition: a hallow or a pit in the ground holding coal that is burning brilliantly.
example_en: The blacksmiths heated the iron in the pit of burning coal.

definition: crazy behaviour.
example_en: People laughed seeing his crazy behaviour.

definition: a changing stage or period.
example_en: The country is now in a transitional stage.

definition: any of the three brothers of Rāma [but applicable esp. to Lakṣmaṇa].
example_en: Lakshmana is referred to as Rama's younger brother.

definition: to take into the stomach food, drink or other substances, etc. by drawing through the throat and oesophagus with a series of voluntary muscular action.
example_en: He swallowed the food quickly.

definition: to cross over into another's area (illegally).
example_en: They crossed the border and went into someone else's area.

definition: an ascetic who has reached the stage of absolute quietness.
example_en: The ascetic in absolute quietness was absorbed in meditation in the forest.

definition: a woody perennial plant having a single usu. elongate main stem generally with few or no branches on its lower part; a tree.
example_en: A tall tree stood in the middle of the forest.

definition: to lose one's patience or composure.
example_en: He lost his patience due to constant harassment.

definition: a metal dining-plate.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಊಟ ಬಡಿಸಲು ಹಿತ್ತಾಳೆಯ ಅಗಲ್ ತಂದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother brought a brass dining-plate to serve the meal.

definition: a thin string or chain.
example_en: She wore a thin chain around her neck.

definition: a person who provokes strong passion for fighting.
example_en: He is a quarrelsome person who always stirs up fights.

definition: being five times as much or as many; five-fold.
example: ಐವಡಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರೂ ಆ ವಸ್ತು ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Even after paying five times the price, that item was not available.

definition: to rescue or preserve from harm, danger, injury, death or destruction; to save.
example_en: He rescued the drowning child.

definition: the final beatitude, considered as the invaluable wealth.
example_en: The saints regarded final beatitude alone as true wealth.

definition: barley-meal mixed with jaggery pieces or powder.
example_en: Grandmother prepared barley-meal mixed with jaggery.

definition: a kind of sea fish, oil sardine.
example: ಬೆಸ್ತರ ದೋಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೂತಾಯಿ ಮೀನು ರಾಶಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A heap of oil sardines lay in the fisherman's boat.

definition: to become black or dull from smoke.
example_en: The kitchen wall became blackened from smoke.

definition: a short plaintive, crying sound (made by woman from throes of childbirth).
example: ಹೆರಿಗೆ ನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಅವಳ ಬಾಯಿಂದ ಮುಲುಕು ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A plaintive crying sound came from her mouth due to labor pain.

definition: the quality or state of being very elegant or highly tidy.
example_en: That house's courtyard shone with neat elegance.

definition: a disease communicated by contact from an infected person to another; a contagious disease.
example: ಆ ಅಂಟುರೋಗ ಬೇಗನೆ ಇಡೀ ಗ್ರಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: That contagious disease spread quickly through the whole village.

definition: a gateway made of bamboo or wooden poles placed horizontally and fastened to two vertical posts, which can be operated by drawing out or pushed in on either side.
example_en: They had built a bamboo gateway near the field.

definition: the beat or pulsation of the heart; throb.
example_en: His heartbeat quickened out of fear.

definition: the duties of, work done by, a servant.
example_en: The servant carried out his duties diligently.

definition: (hist.) a monetary coin of one rupee value.
example_en: A peerakhani coin was displayed in that museum.

definition: the act of piercing with a spear or trident.
example_en: The soldier pierced the enemy with the spear-thrust.

definition: an exhibiting, showing or presenting to view; exhibition; display.
example_en: An exhibition of artworks was held in the city.

definition: a prisoner - a) a person confined in prison, as for some crime; b) a person held in custody.
example_en: That prisoner escaped from the jail.

definition: the time that the life of someone or something continues; the term of a life.
example_en: He was sentenced to imprisonment for the term of his life.

definition: superiority in quality or quantity or numbers; pre-eminence; eminence; excellence.
example: ಆತನ ಸಂಗೀತ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಯ ಅತಿಶಯ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: Everyone knows the excellence of his musical talent.

definition: the fact of being disassociated with; disassociation.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವಿನ ನಿರ್ಯೋಗ ಬಹುಕಾಲದಿಂದ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The disassociation between those two had existed for a long time.

definition: a huge rock detatched from a hill or mountain and displaced.
example_en: Because of the rain a huge rock broke off from the hill and fell down.

definition: that which is carried; a load; a burden.
example_en: The laborer walked carrying a heavy load.

definition: a woman who raises another's child; a foster mother.
example_en: The foster mother raised that child with love.

definition: a man who opposes or strives against.
example_en: Nobody likes a man who opposes others.

definition: the act of gently rubbing over the surface of, with the hand, as in caressing or fondling.
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗುವಿನ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೈತಡವು ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother gently rubbed her hand over the baby's head.

definition: an assemblage of people; a crowd; a multitude.
example_en: A crowd assembled in the market and there was a commotion.

definition: to press, squeeze, using heavy pressure.
example_en: He pressed the bundle of clothes tightly with heavy pressure.

definition: a pestle-like war weapon.
example_en: The warriors fought holding the pestle-like weapon.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance used in curing arthritis.
example_en: The doctor advised him to take the medicinal powder for arthritis.

definition: to pierce with a thorn.
example_en: On the way, a thorn pierced his foot.

definition: a talking or muttering in sleep.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಕಲವರಿಕೆಯ ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿ ಮಗು ಎಚ್ಚರಗೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the sound of grandmother's muttering in sleep, the child woke up.

definition: to treat disrespectfully; to humiliate.
example_en: They humiliated him in front of people.

definition: the direction in which the sunrise apparently occurs; east.
example_en: The sun rises in the east.

definition: a man who steers a ship.
example_en: The steersman brought the ship to the harbor.

definition: a variety of sandal tree (family: Santalaceae) whose wood is yellow.
example_en: The yellow sandal tree is used for making perfume.

definition: during boyhood or girlhood.
example_en: During his boyhood, he used to roam around the town.

definition: to leave a place; to depart.
example_en: They told him to leave that place.

definition: a community mainly hailing from Koḍagu region of Karnāṭaka.
example_en: The Kodava community lives in Kodagu.

definition: an operation - a) the act, process or method of operating; b) any movement or series of movements made in accomplishing a mission or carrying out strategic military plans.
example_en: The army carried out an operation at the border.

definition: a contriver - a) he who can plan with ingenuity; b) he who can bring about or effect by a plan, scheme, etc; c) he who plots or plans secretly (a crime, conspiracy, etc.).
example_en: That schemer hatched the plan in secret.

definition: a salad made of soaked split green gram or Bengal gram seasoned with oil, salt, lime, etc.
example_en: Eating kosambari salad in summer tastes very good.

definition: a disease of the scalp, in which it gets infected with worms.
example: ಅವನ ತಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದುಂದುಱು ಹತ್ತಿ ವೈದ್ಯರನ್ನು ಕಂಡನು.
example_en: A scalp disease with worms developed on his head, so he consulted a doctor.

definition: a man who lacks courage; a coward.
example_en: That coward withdrew from the war.

definition: a particular breed of oxen.
example: ಆ ಜೋಡಿ ಧಣಗರಿ ಎತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That pair of dhaṇagari oxen was sold at the fair.

definition: to be inclined to; to like.
example_en: He liked that work.

definition: completely; entirely.
example_en: They wrote down entirely the matters discussed in the meeting.

definition: an embarrassing condition causing loss of one's esteem.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತು ತಪ್ಪಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕಿಪಾತು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Misspeaking in the meeting, he fell into an embarrassing situation.

definition: the responsibility or burden of one's duty, task, etc.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಈ ಹುದ್ದೆಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಗೌರವ ಬಹಳ ಭಾರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The burden of duty of this post was very heavy for him.

definition: respectful honour; favourable regard.
example_en: People gave him a lot of respect and honour.

definition: a hole or cavity in the ground; a pit.
example_en: Filled with rainwater, the pit became like a pond.

definition: the red in the western sky after the sun set; twilight.
example_en: After sunset, the twilight glow appeared in the sky.

definition: a bent piece of wire, usu. barbed and baited, for catching fish; a fish-hook.
example_en: The fisherman baited the fish-hook with an earthworm.

definition: the state of food eaten not being assimilated with the blood; indigestion.
example: ಎಣ್ಣೆಯ ಪದಾರ್ಥ ತಿಂದು ಆತನಿಗೆ ಅಜಿರ್ತೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: He got indigestion after eating oily food.

definition: what; which; which person; who.
example: ಆವ ದಾರಿ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked which road leads to the village.

definition: (obs.) a school run for a payment to be made by students (usu. at the teacheṛs residence).
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಕೂಲಿಮಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಿ ಬರೆಯುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿತನು.
example_en: That boy learnt to read and write at the fee-paying school.

definition: the reed Amphidonas kurka.
example_en: Reed plants had grown on the bank of the pond.

definition: the act of experience something supreme; the effect of this; the ultimate experience.
example_en: The seeker attained the ultimate experience during meditation.

definition: the short stumps of grain, corn, etc., collectively, left standing after harvesting; stubble.
example_en: Stubble was visible all over the paddy field.

definition: the vine Glycine javanica of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The wild togari vine had spread at the edge of the forest.

definition: the act of sprinkling of, esp. sprinkling of clarified butter upon the sacrificial fire; sprinkle.
example_en: The priest sprinkled clarified butter on the sacrificial fire.

definition: the quality of a slanderer.
example_en: Everyone in the village knew of his slanderous nature.

definition: a man who is deprived of consciousness temporarily; a man who is unconscious.
example_en: They took the unconscious patient to the hospital.

definition: not arrogant; humble.
example_en: He is a humble, not arrogant, gentle person.

definition: a plank (usu. of wood) used to sit on.
example_en: They placed the wooden plank (āsanavaṭṭige) in the yard and sat on it.

definition: (a secured, firm joint or association) to become slack.
example_en: As time passed, their relationship became slack.

definition: great agitation or mental irritation caused by anger, disappointment, jealosy, etc. (and expressed in one's talk, facial expression, etc.).
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಿಡಿಸಿಡಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: She felt great irritation on hearing his words.

definition: relating to one's son or grand son.
example_en: That property came through the right relating to grandsons.

definition: the quality of condition of being patient, composed.
example_en: Even in distress, her composure did not diminish.

definition: the state of being a widow; widowhood.
example_en: Widowhood was a very difficult life for her.

definition: the act associating or being associated.
example_en: The association between the two villages is very old.

definition: a making amends or reparation (for a sin, wrongdoing etc.); atonement.
example_en: He made atonement for his mistake.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A nesare tree had grown by the side of the garden.

definition: good intellectual capacity.
example_en: The teachers praised his good intellectual capacity.

definition: amounting to twenty; twenty.
example_en: She was twenty years of age.

definition: a kind of plant of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The big milk-gourd vine spread up to the roof of the house.

definition: a mixture of coarse sand and rock fragments; gravel.
example_en: They brought gravel in a lorry for road construction.

definition: to come to be seen; to appear.
example_en: The sun appeared from behind the mist.

definition: a favourable or satisfactory outcome or result; success.
example_en: His effort finally met with a favourable outcome.

definition: the state of being helpless; helplessness; inability or powerlessness.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಸಹಾಯಕತೆಯ ಭಾವನೆ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: After the accident, a feeling of helplessness arose in him.

definition: using force; forcefully and suddenly.
example_en: He opened the door forcefully and suddenly.

definition: the husband of one's elder sister.
example: ನನ್ನ ಬಾವ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: My elder sister's husband had come to our house for the festival.

definition: a display having an excessively high regard for one's self, looks, possessions, ability, etc.; vain show; ostentation.
example: ಅವನ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His ostentatious display attracted everyone's attention.

definition: a man who deceives or cheats others, esp. by pretending to be someone or something that he or she is not; an imposter.
example_en: The impostor made everyone believe him with his lies.

definition: a disordered, incomplete, untidy, offensive and unpleasant state or condition.
example: ಕಳ್ಳರು ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮನೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಅರದಾಪರದಾ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the thieves came, the house was left in a disordered, untidy state.

definition: the plant Cocculus hirsutus (= C. villos) of Menispermaceae family.
example_en: The dagadi vine spreads on the ground.

definition: preventing or not liable to purification or decay; free from or keeping away, disease-producing or putrefying micro organisms; aseptic.
example_en: The doctor cleaned the wound with aseptic cloth.

definition: Yamunā river, one of the major rivers of North India.
example_en: The water of the Yamuna flows down from the Himalayas.

definition: to be under the control of; to be under the spell of.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಮಾಟಗಾರನ ಒಚ್ಚತವೋಗಿ ವಿಚಿತ್ರವಾಗಿ ವರ್ತಿಸತೊಡಗಿದನು.
example_en: That person came under the sorcerer's spell and began to behave strangely.

definition: in an intermediate manner (i.e. in between this and that manner).
example: ಆ ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಿಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಪ್ಪಿನ ಉಂತು ಇದೆ.
example_en: That color is in an intermediate manner between white and black.

definition: foul; very bad; spiteful, ill-tempered; intending or intended to give pain; wicked.
example_en: Everyone was upset by his wicked, ill-tempered behaviour.

definition: the act or occupation of stitching clothes, embroidering, etc.
example_en: She had special expertise in the craft of stitching.

definition: to move unsteadily from side to side, as in walking or while standing; to wobble or totter.
example_en: The old man walked along the path, tottering unsteadily.

definition: to begin; to initiate; to perform the first act.
example_en: The minister initiated the new project.

definition: kindled; lighted.
example_en: The kindled lamp lit up the room.

definition: an iron block on which smiths hammer metal into shape; an anvil.
example_en: The blacksmith hammered the iron on the anvil.

definition: a zealous, enthusiastic man.
example: ಆತ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಭ್ರಮಕಾಱನಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He worked zealously as an enthusiastic man in the festival preparations.

definition: (icon.) a strong stone that is suitable for carving an idol.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದಿಂದ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಪುಂಶಿಲೆಯನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ತಂದನು.
example_en: The sculptor selected and brought good idol-carving stone from the hill.

definition: once more; again; anew.
example_en: He told that story once more.

definition: an opening in a meshed fabric.
example_en: The fisherman was repairing the opening in the mesh of the net.

definition: the quality of being free from dust; cleanliness.
example: ಆ ಸ್ಥಳದ ವಿರಜ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹಿಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The cleanliness of that place pleased everyone's mind.

definition: to bring or cause to come under one's control; to subject to.
example_en: The soldiers brought that region under their control.

definition: the sacred book of Islam believed to contain revelations made to Mohammed by Allah; Koran.
example_en: He reads the Koran every day.

definition: an afflicted condition; pain; suffering; affliction; trouble.
example_en: That family was suffering from the affliction of poverty.

definition: a person or thing very much like another; a copy; a counterpart.
example_en: Those two pictures are exact counterparts of each other.

definition: to become speechless.
example_en: Out of fear he became speechless.

definition: to praise; to extol; to laud.
example_en: The poets praise the king's valor.

definition: a man who executes or has to execute another's order; he who is at command.
example_en: Everyone in the army must be a man who obeys orders.

definition: a man whose appearance has been deformed; a defaced man.
example_en: After the accident, he became a disfigured man.

definition: an erstwhile brass-farthing of smallest denomination.
example_en: Grandfather would not waste even a tiny farthing.

definition: that is made liquid; liquefied.
example_en: The butter became liquefied in the sun.

definition: the object of desire.
example_en: He obtained the object of his desire.

definition: (burning) brightly or blazingly.
example_en: The fire in the hearth was burning brightly.

definition: a vying; a competition.
example_en: The competition between the two athletes was intense.

definition: a species of tortoise.
example_en: The species of tortoise was moving slowly on the pond's bank.

definition: the jackal Canis aureus.
example_en: The jackal howled at night.

definition: end of one's life; death.
example: ಅವನ ಮಱಲ್ ಇಡೀ ಗ್ರಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ದುಃಖ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His death brought sorrow to the whole village.

definition: front and back.
example_en: The soldiers were surrounded by enemies from front and back.

definition: to refuse to grant or give; to deny.
example_en: The officer refused to grant his application.

definition: a woollen blanket.
example_en: In winter, she wrapped herself in a woollen blanket.

definition: the act or business of lending and borrowing; financial transactions; banking.
example_en: His lending and borrowing business was well known in the village.

definition: a projection from a fortification; a bastion.
example_en: The soldiers observed the enemies from the bastion.

definition: upward and downward movements of prices in the market.
example_en: Upward and downward price movements occur daily in the stock market.

definition: service; attendance.
example_en: The servants attended upon the guests.

definition: the true or actual state of a matter; truth.
example_en: He always speaks the truth.

definition: the stonelike seed of certain fruits, as of a mango; a stone; a seedpod.
example_en: Do not throw away the mango stone.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: A mura plant had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: the act or an instance of remaining.
example: ಅವನ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಗಡೆ ಕೇವಲ ಎರಡು ದಿನಗಳು.
example_en: His stay in the town was only two days.

definition: bad policy, course of conduct; evil course; wrong path.
example: ಅನಯದಿಂದ ನಡೆದ ರಾಜನು ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The king who acted with bad policy lost the trust of his subjects.

definition: to excite the surface nerves of, as by touching or stroking lightly with the finger, a feather, etc., so as to cause involuntary twitching, a pleasant tingling, laughter, etc.; to tickle.
example_en: They tickled the baby's belly and made it laugh.

definition: characterised by speed of motion; rapid; swift; speedy.
example_en: The horse ran at a rapid pace.

definition: lack o order, system.
example_en: Lack of order was clearly visible in that office.

definition: the act of biting or stinging; a bite.
example_en: The snake's bite happened on his leg.

definition: an occupation, vocation undertaken for earning one's livelihood.
example_en: He was searching for a new livelihood occupation.

definition: a hindrance; an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: Obstacles were encountered all along the journey.

definition: an elephant.
example_en: The elephant walked majestically through the forest.

definition: act of tickling; titillation.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ತಂಗಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಳಗುಳಿ ಇಟ್ಟು ಕೆಣಕಿದನು.
example_en: The boy teased his sister by tickling her.

definition: any word that ends with the letter 'ł' original to Kannaḍa language.
example: ಕವಿಯು ಕುಳಾಂತವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಪದ್ಯವನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet composed a beautiful verse using a word ending in the letter ł.

definition: hot oil or inflammable oil.
example: ಒಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಉರಿಯೆಣ್ಣೆ ಇಟ್ಟು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು.
example_en: One must handle the inflammable oil kept on the stove carefully.

definition: of or made of the horn (of an animal); horny.
example_en: The hunter used a knife made of horn.

definition: a state of mental distress; trouble; agony.
example_en: Amid the household troubles, she got no rest at all.

definition: to hang loosely; to walk or move unsteadily; to waddle.
example_en: The old man walked along the path, waddling unsteadily.

definition: any of various painful conditions of the joints and muscles, characterised by inflammation, stiffness, etc., including rheumatoid arthritis, bursitis, and neuritis; rheumatism.
example_en: Her rheumatism in the knee increased during winter.

definition: a kind of weapon.
example_en: The warrior used a weapon called surayu.

definition: that which does not occupy space and is not perceptible to the senses in any way; a thing which cannot be considered as 'matteṛ.
example_en: The scripture says that the soul is something immaterial.

definition: to draw fully.
example_en: He drew the water fully from the well with a rope.

definition: to take place; to happen; to occur.
example_en: A strange incident occurred in the village.

definition: botheration caused by the infestation of bed-bugs.
example_en: The bed-bug infestation on the old cot was excessive.

definition: the stately gait of swans.
example_en: Her gait is beautiful like the stately gait of swans.

definition: to be connected with, related to; to have relation with.
example_en: This matter is connected with my family.

definition: that which moves on feet.
example: ಪಾದಚಾರಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ದಾರಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a separate path for pedestrians beside the road.

definition: to catch or seize by a pair of tongs.
example: ಅವಳು ಸಣ್ಣ ತುಣುಕನ್ನು ಇಕ್ಕುೞಿಸಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: She seized the small piece with the tongs and put it into the vessel.

definition: to move (a thing) against something else or move (things) over each other with pressure and friction, as to make the former become powder; to rub.
example: ಅವಳು ಅರಿಶಿನದ ಕೊಂಬನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ತೇಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: She was rubbing the turmeric stick on the stone.

definition: a discharge of blood caused by various kinds of disease.
example_en: Blood discharge caused by disease began in him.

definition: a dent made on a top ( a wooden toy) with the pointed end of the nail of another top.
example_en: A dent formed on the top during the game.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example_en: The teacher snapped his fingers with a chutuka sound and silenced the children.

definition: the cotton plant Gossypium hirsutum (= G. mexicanum) of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The doddahatti cotton crop had grown well in the field.

definition: a time or opportunity for action which comes in due rotation or order to each of a number of persons, animals, etc.; a time; a turn.
example_en: Now it is your turn to speak.

definition: a financial statement and programmes for a certain period put before the Parliament or a legislative assembly by the minister for exchequer; budget.
example_en: The government presents the budget every year.

definition: an institution, formal or informal, for education esp. primary school.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಅಕರಖಂಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A primary school was established for the children in that village.

definition: a leasing out or taking on lease an extent of land on an agreed rate or amount of tax.
example_en: In that village, the land has been leased out on a fixed rate.

definition: at a later time; subsequently; afterward.
example_en: Afterwards he admitted his mistake.

definition: (one's) left thigh.
example_en: An injection was given on his left thigh.

definition: a kind of small drum.
example_en: The sound of the small drum was heard during the ritual.

definition: to cause to oppose or to rise in revolt.
example_en: That leader's words caused the people to rise in revolt.

definition: people lacking virtues or merits.
example_en: Father said not to associate with people lacking virtues.

definition: spoken words.
example_en: People did not believe his spoken words.

definition: a variety in mango trees, the fruit of which has a parrot-beak-like bend at the extremity.
example: ಈ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿಣಿಮೂತಿ ತಳಿಯ ಮಾವಿನ ಮರವಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a parrot-beak variety mango tree in this garden.

definition: a spool on which thread, wire, tape, film, a net, etc. is wound; a reel.
example_en: She wound the thread onto the reel.

definition: to crack the finger knuckles with a sharp, short sound.
example_en: He cracked his finger knuckles in anger.

definition: a kind of cotton plant.
example_en: There was a nelavatti cotton crop in that field.

definition: the state in which a thing is.
example_en: The state in which the goods were was inspected.

definition: (a large number of persons) to stand in a line; to form a queue.
example_en: The travellers stood forming a queue near the bus.

definition: crowded with people.
example_en: The fair ground was crowded with people.

definition: a hole or cavity in the ground.
example: ಮಳೆ ನೀರು ನಿಂತು ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಂಚರು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A hole formed in the yard where rainwater collected.

definition: to come running.
example_en: Hearing about the trouble, friends came running.

definition: (myth.) one of the eight principal cobras.
example_en: The story of the serpent Karkota appears in the mythology.

definition: a hard-hearted, unyielding, relentless man.
example: ಆ ಕ್ರೂರಚಿತ್ತ ಬಡವರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕರುಣೆ ತೋರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That hard-hearted man showed no mercy to the poor.

definition: a meaningless term used at the end of each quarter of a song, merely for rhyme.
example: ಆ ಹಾಡಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲಿನ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ರುವ್ವಿ ಬರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A meaningless rhyming refrain came at the end of every line of that song.

definition: a good, superior or supreme knowledge, scholarship.
example: ಆ ಪಂಡಿತನಿಗೆ ಸದ್ವಿದ್ಯೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಪಾರ ಗೌರವವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That scholar had immense respect for superior knowledge.

definition: an investigation, as into an incident; an enquiry.
example_en: The police began an investigation into the theft.

definition: to chew slowly and steadily (a crisp piece of food), with a crunching sound.
example_en: The children sat chewing groundnuts with a crunching sound.

definition: a slapping of one's shoulder or thigh (an indication given by a wrestler to his opponent).
example: ಜಟ್ಟಿಯು ಎದುರಾಳಿಗೆ ಸೆಡ್ಡು ಹೊಡೆದು ಸವಾಲು ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The wrestler gave a challenge by slapping his shoulder at his opponent.

definition: to measure quantity, volume, etc.; to measure.
example_en: The shopkeeper measured the quantity of rice.

definition: Sarasvati, the Goddess of Learning.
example_en: The students prayed to Sarasvati and began the lesson.

definition: a good-looking, well-decorated frame-work.
example_en: The decorated framework looked very beautiful for the wedding.

definition: difficult - a) needing much effort or skill; b) troublesome, perplexing; c) (of a person) a not easy to please or satisfy; d) characterised by hardships or problems (a difficult period in on's life).
example: ಈ ಕ್ಲಿಷ್ಟ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಲು ಬಹಳ ಸಮಯ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took a long time to solve this difficult question.

definition: a small village.
example_en: That small village has only a handful of houses.

definition: that is bestowing emancipation; that helps getting freedom from transmigration.
example_en: That practice was one that bestowed emancipation.

definition: to be or become equal.
example_en: The strength of both factions eventually became equal.

definition: the act or an instance of ending; an end.
example: ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮದ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ ಸಂಜೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The conclusion of the program took place at six in the evening.

definition: not working; not engaged; being idle.
example_en: He is now sitting idle at home, being unemployed.

definition: that which is fit or apt to accompany.
example: ಈ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಆ ಸೀರೆಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕಸಾರೆಯಾಗಿ ಸೂಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This cloth is suitable as a fitting accompaniment to that saree.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard or defend; to protect.
example_en: The king protected his subjects.

definition: a kind of perfume.
example: ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮರುಜ ಎಂಬ ಪರಿಮಳ ದ್ರವ್ಯ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had kept a perfume called maruja in the box.

definition: the condition or quality of being abundant; plentifulness; abundance.
example: ಈ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾವಿನ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಬಹುಲತೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is an abundance of mangoes in this town.

definition: a differentiating between two or among many persons, things, etc., based on class, quality, rank, influence or any other preference.
example: ಅವರು ಜನರಲ್ಲಿ ತರತಮ ಮಾಡದೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They helped everyone without making any distinction among the people.

definition: (a disease) to be got rid of; to be cured.
example: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಔಷಧಿಯಿಂದ ಆ ರೋಗಿಯ ಜ್ವರ ಗುಣಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: With the right medicine, that patient's fever was cured.

definition: to exhibit, display (something).
example_en: He displayed his skill.

definition: skillful or clever, esp. in achieving a purpose; artful.
example_en: She is a skillful dancer in performance.

definition: a cursing or being cursed.
example_en: The curse on that family continued for generations.

definition: a thin soup made of tamarind fruit, spices, etc. (with or without toor dal).
example_en: Mother made tamarind soup for the meal.

definition: to exempt (a person) from paying a tax.
example_en: The government exempted poor farmers from the tax.

definition: a machine, instrument or implement that is defective or useless.
example_en: That useless machine lay there without working.

definition: a thick mixture of clay, and sometimes sand, with water, that is impervious to water.
example_en: The pit was filled with sticky mire, making the path difficult.

definition: to become white or whiter; to be whitened.
example_en: After the rain, the wall became white.

definition: a gland near the root of the neck that produces lymphocytes, which is most prominent at puberty, and later disappears or becomes vestigial: thymus gland.
example_en: The thymus gland is most prominent in children at puberty.

definition: that much.
example: ಅಯ್ಸು ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಇದ್ದರೂ ಅವನಿಗೆ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Even having that much wealth, he had no satisfaction.

definition: spiced fried-gram that is crisp.
example_en: Grandmother made crisp spiced fried-gram for the evening.

definition: encouraging; giving courage, hope, confidence to.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕ ಮಾತುಗಳು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಕ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿದವು.
example_en: The teacher's encouraging words gave the students strength.

definition: a type of black stone formerly used to test the purity of gold or silver by the streak left on it when it was rubbed with the metal; a touchstone.
example_en: He rubbed the silver on the touchstone and examined it.

definition: a preparation; plan; arrangements.
example_en: Preparations were made for the wedding.

definition: an armour for the breast; a chest-guard.
example_en: The king's chest-guard was adorned with gold.

definition: a material of great price, high worth or esteem.
example_en: That king possessed many precious materials of great worth.

definition: a god; a deity.
example_en: The god protects his devotees.

definition: to represent in a picture or pictorially by painting or drawing.
example_en: The artist depicted the village scene in a painting.

definition: the surface of something.
example_en: The surface of the leaf was soft.

definition: gone afar.
example_en: His village is gone far away from here.

definition: to get fulfilled one's desires, expectations, needs, demands, etc.; to be satisfied.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅಂಕ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅವನು ತೃಪ್ತಿಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He gets satisfied when he scores good marks in the exam.

definition: a man who earns money.
example_en: The household ran on the labour of the earning man.

definition: the organ of vision; the eye.
example_en: Her eye was shining beautifully.

definition: a man belonging to or native of the country Nepala.
example: ಆ ಲೇಪಾಳಿಗ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That man native of Nepala, a merchant, was selling clothes at the market.

definition: the act of twisting another's neck.
example: ಆ ದುಷ್ಟ ಗೋಳ್ಮುರಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಎತ್ತನ್ನು ಹಿಂಸಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That wicked man tortured the ox by twisting its neck.

definition: he who fights; a fighter.
example_en: That fighter never admits defeat.

definition: the act of abusing, blaming; abuse; blame.
example: ಆತನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಜನರ ಹೀಯಾಳಿಕೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: People's abuse of him still continued.

definition: incomplete - a) lacking a part or parts; not whole; not full ; b) unfinished; not concluded; c) not perfect; not thorough.
example_en: That building's work is still incomplete.

definition: a ceasing to be seen; disappearance.
example: ಕತ್ತಲಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಗಡಪ್ಪು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His disappearance in the dark surprised everyone.

definition: a heap; a pile of things.
example_en: There was a pile of firewood in front of the hut.

definition: pasta made of wheat flour in the form of long, thin strings, cooked by boiling or steaming and served with a sauce; spaghetti.
example_en: For breakfast we made spaghetti.

definition: a sea or ocean the surface of which is rising due to the attraction of the moon and sun; a sea or ocean in tides.
example_en: On the full moon night, the rising sea touched the shore.

definition: a large frog, Rana catesbeiana, of Ranidae family that has teeth in the upper jaw, and a deep, loud croak; bull-frog.
example_en: The loud croak of the bullfrog was heard at night.

definition: the office of an accountant.
example_en: He works in the accountant's office.

definition: to add grace to; to embellish.
example_en: The flowers embellished the house.

definition: an aged man.
example_en: The aged man of the village was respected by everyone.

definition: a concerted performance of vocal music, instrumental music and dance.
example_en: At the festival, the concert of song, music and dance enthralled the audience.

definition: a liquid forced into the colon through the anus, as a purgative; enema.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient an enema.

definition: a kind of pulse.
example_en: The farmers grew that pulse crop in the field.

definition: a narrow passage or room; a strait.
example_en: Only one person can pass through the narrow passage of the house.

definition: a small or narrow place.
example_en: The children played in the narrow space between the houses.

definition: a body that is callous.
example: ಕಷ್ಟದ ಕೆಲಸದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಜಡ್ಡುದೇಹ ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಗಡುಸಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of the hard work, his callous body became even tougher.

definition: profit; gain.
example_en: A good profit was gained in this business.

definition: the maximum price.
example_en: The maximum price of gold is rising day by day.

definition: to jump from above to a lower place.
example_en: The cat jumped down from the wall.

definition: to inlay - a) to set (pieces of wood, metal, etc.) into a surface to make a design that is usu. level with the surface; b) to decorate with such pieces.
example_en: The carpenter inlaid a design on the door.

definition: a colourless, crystalline compound, potassium nitrate (KNO3), used in gunpowder, medicine, preservative, etc.; saltpetre.
example_en: Saltpetre is used in the manufacture of gunpowder.

definition: Indra, the lord of gods.
example: ಬಿಡೌಜಸನ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದದಿಂದ ಮಳೆ ಸುರಿಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The legend says the rain fell by the blessing of Indra.

definition: a jungle-fowl; gallus sonnerati.
example_en: The jungle-fowl was crowing in the forest.

definition: the act of dividing, apportioning.
example_en: The family members together did the division of the property.

definition: a coercive behaviour or oppressive way of talking.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಸಾಲ ವಸೂಲಿಗೆ ರೋಫು ತೋರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That merchant showed coercive behaviour to collect the debt.

definition: a series of consecutive days.
example_en: The series of festival days is recorded in the almanac.

definition: knowledge acquired by systematic study in any field of scholarly application; learning.
example_en: She acquired the learning of music from her teacher.

definition: to be plundered, looted.
example_en: That village was looted by the robbers.

definition: red light (of the rising sun).
example: ಪೂರ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಂಗದಿರ್ ಮೂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತುದಿಯನ್ನು ಕೆಂಪಾಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the east the red light of the rising sun appeared and reddened the hilltop.

definition: to overflow; to go beyond the limits.
example: ನದಿಯ ನೀರು ದಡ ಉಕ್ಕಿಱಿದು ಹೊಲಗಳಿಗೆ ನುಗ್ಗಿತು.
example_en: The river water overflowed its banks and rushed into the fields.

definition: something that restricts; a restriction.
example_en: The government imposed a restriction on movement.

definition: up to the place of.
example: ಊರ ತನಕ ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಜೊತೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came with me up to the village.

definition: a kind of disease.
example_en: She contracted the disease called hegalu.

definition: a particular variety of oxen.
example_en: That farmer has haṇabiri breed of oxen.

definition: to avoid or prevent from happening.
example_en: He tried to avoid the quarrel.

definition: an outer garment covering each leg separately and usu. extending from the waist to the ankle; trousers; pants.
example: ಅವನು ಹೊಸ ಕಾಲುಕುಬುಸವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He wore new trousers and went to school.

definition: a person chosen to render a decision in a dispute; a judge; an arbiter; an umpire.
example_en: The panchayat's judge gave a just decision.

definition: a metaphor in which the words describing the object and the one which is compared to are not compounded together.
example_en: In this line the poet has employed a disjoined metaphor.

definition: the metallic sound (as that of cymbal or khanjari ).
example_en: The metallic sound of the cymbal was heard far away.

definition: (used reflexively of third person singular nouns) individuality such as the sum of the characteristics or qualities peculiar to a person.
example_en: Every artist should preserve his own individuality.

definition: the tree Syzygium hemisphaericum (= Eugenia heisphaerica) of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: The fruits of the Syzygium hemisphaericum tree appear black.

definition: a slapping of one's shoulder or thigh (an indication given by a wrestler to his opponent).
example: ಕುಸ್ತಿಪಟು ಎದೆ ಸೊಡ್ಡು ಹೊಡೆದು ಕಣಕ್ಕೆ ಇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The wrestler stepped into the arena after slapping his chest as a challenge.

definition: a person who has committed, is commiting or has the tendency to commit, heinous sin.
example_en: That heinous sinner is serving punishment in jail.

definition: the act of exalting to the ranking of a god; deification.
example: ಜನರು ರಾಜನನ್ನು ದೈವೀಕರಣ ಮಾಡಿ ಪೂಜಿಸಲು ತೊಡಗಿದರು.
example_en: The people began to worship the king, exalting him to the rank of a god.

definition: the flesh of the hemp of an ox, camel, etc.
example_en: In that region, they used the ox's hemp-flesh as food.

definition: an opposing statement or argument.
example_en: His opposing statement confused everyone.

definition: the last days or period in one's tenure of reign.
example_en: The last days of that king's reign were full of hardships.

definition: a challenge putforward in reply to anotehṛs challenge.
example_en: The rival threw a counter-challenge at the champion.

definition: a man who travels; a traveller.
example_en: That traveller went around distant towns.

definition: a person who habitually delays; a procrastinator.
example: ಅವನು ದೊಡ್ಡ ತಡಮಾರಿ, ಯಾವ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನೂ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He is a great procrastinator and never does any work on time.

definition: a man who steals or appropriates portable property etc. from another or others; a thief.
example_en: The thief broke into the house at night.

definition: to repent or have remorse feeling for a past action or inaction.
example_en: After making the mistake, he began to repent.

definition: (bot.) the stamens and the parts belonging to them, collectively; all the microsporophylls of a flower; the androecium.
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನ ಕೇಸರಮಂಡಲ ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣದಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That flower's androecium was covered with yellow color.

definition: an elder sister.
example: ಅಗ್ರಜೆ ತಂದೆಯ ಜೊತೆ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The elder sister helped their father with the work.

definition: a number of sheets of paper, parchment, etc. with writing or printing on them, fastened together along one edge; a book.
example_en: She bought a new book from the shop.

definition: wet an slimy soil; mire.
example_en: After the rain, it is difficult to walk in the mire.

definition: an indeclinable used to express abhorrence, detestation, deep repugnance, etc..
example_en: Yuck, speaking in that manner is wrong.

definition: to set, position in a certain place.
example_en: He positioned the seat in front of the assembly.

definition: a stupid man.
example_en: That stupid man does not know how to calculate.

definition: a crippled leg.
example_en: That beggar could not walk because he had a crippled leg.

definition: a gay, light-hearted action or mood; fun; joking.
example_en: The children's joking and fun was nice to watch.

definition: blazing flame rising from a fire.
example_en: The blazing flame rising from the fire seemed to touch the sky.

definition: to become blunt.
example_en: From constant use, the blade of the knife became blunt.

definition: an organised political group which seeks to elect its candidates to office and thus to direct government policies; a party.
example_en: That party won in the election.

definition: to become solidified into grains; to become crystallised.
example_en: The sugar syrup cooled and crystallised into grains.

definition: a kind of vessel.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಳಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೀರು ತುಂಬಲು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They use the vessel in the kitchen to fill water.

definition: the trailing annual vine Cucumis sativus of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The cucumber vine spread in the garden.

definition: an agriculgural implement used to break the lumps of earth in the field.
example: ರೈತನು ಹಲಿವೆಯಿಂದ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಗಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಡೆದನು.
example_en: The farmer broke the lumps of soil in the field with the harrow.

definition: a long, sharp-pointed tooth on either side of the upper jaw and lower jaw, between the incisors and the bicuspids.
example_en: The lion's long sharp canine teeth grip powerfully.

definition: (pl.) six legs.
example: ಆ ಜೀವಿಗೆ ಮಯ್ಯೆರಡಡಿ ಇದ್ದವೆಂದು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The text says that creature had six legs.

definition: that which is being done or is undertaken.
example_en: This work is currently being undertaken.

definition: the act of drawing or pulling towards; a hauling or dragging.
example_en: By the pulling of the rope, the boat reached the shore.

definition: a vessel with a snout for serving liquid foods.
example_en: The oil was in the spouted vessel in the kitchen.

definition: the person to whom mail, etc. is addressed; addressee.
example_en: The parcel did not reach the correct addressee.

definition: he who obliterates his enemies.
example_en: That warrior became famous as an obliterator of enemies.

definition: to pay or adjust payment towards one's payable account.
example: ಅವನು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಜಮಾಕಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He pays towards his loan account every month.

definition: time duration beween two points of time, events, etc.; interval.
example_en: The interval between the two classes was short.

definition: a thin, bare plant not having leaves, flowers, etc.
example_en: Without rain, a bare leafless plant stood in the paddy field.

definition: a fight between archers.
example_en: A fight between archers took place between the two armies.

definition: the neck.
example_en: A golden chain adorned his neck.

definition: a long, thick piece of wood, used in building as a horizontal support for a roof, ceiling, etc.; a beam.
example_en: The carpenter fixed a strong beam to the ceiling.

definition: that which forebodes (or supposed to forebode) happening of something bad or harmful; a bad omen.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಎದುರಾದ ನಾಯಿ ಅವಶಕುನ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಭಾವಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He thought that the dog he encountered in the morning was a bad omen.

definition: to come as a support, buttress.
example_en: He came to support his friend.

definition: an acrobatic stunt performed by turning the body one full revolution forward or backward, heels over head.
example_en: That boy performed a somersault on the stage.

definition: skill in using one's hands; manual or manipulative skill; an artful management.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at his manual skill.

definition: a pit, dipression made by the erosion of soil cause by the flow of water.
example_en: A pit was formed in the field due to the flow of the stream.

definition: helpless; weak.
example: ಆ ಬಡಪಾಯಿ ಮಗು ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳುತ್ತಾ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That helpless child stood crying on the road.
